svg.title: From request to evidence: the harness pipeline
svg.desc: Every request is perceived, routed to one lane, previewed before any write, guarded, verified and logged.
svg.text: From request to evidence: the harness pipeline
Every request is perceived, routed to one lane, previewed before any write, guarded, verified and logged.
source dirs and markers. Never assumes
SdlcRouter picks phase + gate; Decider picks route, lane and confidence. Risky
or low-confidence routes ask first (si). Every reply shows a chip: lane · stack ·
LLM lists up to 6 file paths. spec.md is protected from AI writes.
One completion per file; small-model aware prompts.
Unified diff, bounded to 6 files · 120 lines. Stored as
si aplicar writes everything · no discards · diff <path>
allow | confirm | deny. Denies .env, keys, secrets/ and
Local check: secrets, scope vs. evidenced sources, SRP, debug
git stash --include-untracked before the first write. Reversible.
FilesystemMCP on a validated workspace root (fix for EROFS).
Real commands must run and exit 0 → QualityEvidence.
No pending diffs + verified contract + evidence → Done, else
.alpaquitay/ in the workspace · plain files, git-friendly
F · A · B · L · E = FABLE-5 principles
